description: Searches Well Told's catalog of custom gifts for clients, employees, teams and events: glassware, tumblers and bottles personalized with a map of a meaningful place, a logo or text. Use it when someone is looking for custom, branded or personalized gifts in quantity. Filters by budget per unit, quantity (minimum order and volume pricing), category, and in-hand date (lead time). Returns each product's id, live price, minimum, estimated delivery date, the design types it offers (map_logo, logo_only) and its Logo Only areas.

budget_per_unit.description: Budget per gift in US dollars

in_hand_date.description: Date the gifts must arrive, YYYY-MM-DD

occasion.description: Occasion or recipients, e.g. 'client thank-you', 'new hires'

name: search_catalog
title: Search Well Told corporate catalog
